export type SendKeyMode = "enter" | "cmd-enter";

export const SEND_KEY_PRESETS: Record<SendKeyMode, Record<string, readonly Shortcut[]>> = {
  "enter": {
    "chat.newLine": [logical("Enter", ["shift"])],

    "chat.question.submit": [logical("Enter")],

  "cmd-enter": {
    "chat.newLine": [logical("Enter"), logical("Enter", ["shift"])],
